image_description: A close-up, slightly angled shot of a vintage-style comic book or pulp magazine lying on a wooden surface. The cover features a dark background with a teal/green border. The title at the top reads 'MUTLOCHS' (or similar gibberish) in a distressed, blocky font. The central illustration depicts two stylized, pale figures: one appears to be a seated or crouching humanoid with wild hair, and the other is a quadrupedal creature resembling a horse or dog, rendered in a rough, sketch-like style. Below the illustration is a block of text that is largely illegible/gibberish, mimicking credits or a tagline. The lighting creates a glare on the glossy cover.
